B.LEAGUE Game Info

Source: R/bleague.R
bleague_game_info.Rd

Game header of one B.LEAGUE game: competition, round, venue, officials, tip-off, both teams and the scores.

Endpoint: GET https://b-league.s3.amazonaws.com/web_json/v2_genius_contexts/{schedule_key}/{latest}.json (the v1 feed, or the game page's embed, when v2 does not hold the game).

One row. year is the season START year and season the END year (year + 1). Team ids are text (the v1 feed sends integers, v2 strings). home_score_p1 ... p14 are the points scored IN each period (the v1 header carries 14 slots, v2 four; use bleague_period_scores() for the played periods). The v1 header has many columns v2 lacks (game_no, event, winning / losing streaks, weather, report text); they are NA on v2. temperature and humidity were NA in every observed body, so their type is an assumption.

Usage

bleague_game_info(schedule_key, season = NULL)

Arguments

schedule_key

(integer required): B.LEAGUE ScheduleKey, one global sequence across B1, B2, B3 and every season, e.g. 504734 (B1 2025-26 sec 1, Alvark Tokyo v Utsunomiya Brex); the schedule_key column of bleague_schedule().

season

(integer optional): a guard, the season END year the game must belong to; a context whose Year differs raises hoopR_asset_fetch. NULL (default) = no check (the key alone selects the game).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per game. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "bleague_game_info")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

The B.LEAGUE (Japan Professional Basketball League: B1, B2, B3) wrappers mirror sportsdataverse-py's sportsdataverse.basketball.bleague wrappers of the same names: same arguments, the same snake_case columns and types, one row per sportsdataverse-py row.

Unofficial and unsupported. The game contexts are JSON objects in B.LEAGUE's own public S3 bucket (b-league.s3.amazonaws.com, the store its game pages read), and the schedule, standings and game_detail pages of www.bleague.jp are parsed here. Neither host publishes terms for this use (the site's /terms/ answers 404; robots.txt sets a Crawl-delay only for msnbot and bingbot). Requests are spaced at least one second apart per host; 429 and 5xx answers are retried (three attempts). The site's terms were not reviewed; check them before you republish the data.

Seasons are END years (season = 2026 is 2025-26); the site's own Year / year= is the START year, so the request sends year = season - 1. Game wrappers take the global schedule_key (one integer sequence across B1, B2, B3 and every season: 1 = the 2016-17 opener, 5856 in 2020-21, 500017 in 2022-23, 504734 / 505508 B1 / B2 and 10693 B3 in 2025-26); list a day's keys with bleague_schedule().

Feeds. A game is read from the v2 feed (B1/B2 from 2020-21), else the v1 feed (B3 and B1/B2 2018-2020), else the game page's embedded copy (the only source of 2016-17 and 2017-18), decided at run time. v2 ids are strings, v1 ids integers: both become text here. v1 adds leaders and the score track; the team-rebound codes 18 / 19 are swapped between the feeds and a v1 substitution is one row where v2 has two. Player and team names are Japanese (English names only on the box score and header). Game wrappers serve FINISHED games only. Each game wrapper fetches the context itself (two requests): fetch once per game per wrapper you need.

Errors are classed conditions, never a warning plus an empty frame: hoopR_no_data (no source holds the game, a schedule day without games, HTTP 404), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer or out-of-range argument, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: another status, a transport error, a non-JSON or non-HTML body, an error or changed body, an unfinished game, a context or page for another game, season, tab or day, a truncated schedule list, or layout drift). All inherit hoopR_error.

See also

family_b_league lists every function in this family.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(bleague_game_info(schedule_key = 504734))
#> ── B.LEAGUE game info from b-league.s3.amazonaws.com ──────────── hoopR 3.2.0 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-11-10 01:58:40 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 103
#>   schedule_key season feed   year  code event convention_key convention_class
#>          <int>  <int> <chr> <int> <int> <int> <chr>                     <int>
#> 1       504734   2026 v2     2025   546    NA 514                           1
#> # ℹ 95 more variables: round <int>, game_no <int>, schedule_state <int>,
#> #   schedule_conference <int>, interleague <lgl>, stadium_cd <chr>,
#> #   attendance <int>, game_datetime <dttm>, game_start_time <dttm>,
#> #   game_end_time <dttm>, max_period <int>, current_period <int>,
#> #   rest_time <int>, game_ended <lgl>, record_fixed <lgl>, box_exists <lgl>,
#> #   pbp_exists <lgl>, picture_exists <lgl>, report_exists <lgl>,
#> #   home_win <lgl>, commissioner_id <chr>, referee_id <chr>, …
